key_concepts: Endothermic reactions absorb heat from the surroundings
Exothermic reactions release heat to the surroundings
Dissolving Epsom salt in water is endothermic
Oxidation of steel wool with vinegar is exothermic
The Haber-Bosch ammonia production reaction is exothermic
Melting, boiling, and evaporation are endothermic changes
Freezing, respiration, and combustion are exothermic changes
Temperature, concentration, surface area, and catalysts affect reaction rate
Green chemistry principles can improve industrial chemical processes
